subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should this PR's runtime stale-check path handle legacy no-code, no-pluginId missing-source diagnostics during upgrade, or should that legacy cleanup move to doctor/migration code instead?
rationale: The explicit-marker fix follows prior maintainer direction, but the legacy branch intentionally changes persisted SQLite cache behavior for upgraded users and green CI does not settle that compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Require proof, then accept runtime invalidation
options.body: Ask for redacted latest-head terminal output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostics_json row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds before merging this runtime fallback.

options.title: Move legacy cleanup to doctor/migration
options.body: Keep the explicit marker and schema fix but move no-code legacy cleanup out of runtime if maintainers want steady-state registry loading to avoid legacy interpretation.

options.title: Narrow to new marker only
options.body: Drop the legacy no-code branch and accept that already-persisted pre-code orphan rows require a separate repair path.

recommendation.title: Require proof, then accept runtime invalidation
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted latest-head terminal output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostics_json row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds before merging this runtime fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc gave the predecessor's explicit-marker direction and has recent ownership signals in the plugin registry/store paths.
